dataset_name: India Local-Store POS Sales Register (Kerala-style grocery/produce store)
status: DOWNLOADED_NOT_REGISTERED (research files only; not wired into the app registry or backend)
geography: India - a single local store (item names such as NEDRA POKA, ULLI, MALLILLA, PAPPDAM point to Kerala; the uploader does not state the location)
business_domain: Retail POS billing register - groceries, fresh produce, dairy, snacks (line items with GST slab)
data_type: real (anonymised POS export) - authenticity assessed from the file itself, see metadata.md
provenance: UNVERIFIED beyond the uploader's statement: 'retail sales transaction records collected from a local store/POS billing system'. No store name, no paper, no institution.
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (per the Kaggle dataset page): attribution required, NON-COMMERCIAL use only, derivatives must be shared under the same licence
citation: Alan Kuriyan. Retail Sales Register Data [Data set]. Kaggle. https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/alankuriyan/retail-sales-register-data (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)
download_method: Kaggle public anonymous dataset-download endpoint (no login, no token)
original_files: sales_register_data.csv (94,290 rows x 10 cols; zip 1.1 MB)
absent_never_invented: customer id (all rows are 'LOCAL SALES' except 285 rows to one named party)
bill/transaction id as a clean field
transformations: scripts/prepare_india_pos_register.py: remove thousands separators; coerce numerics; parse dd/mm/yyyy; recompute line_amount = qty*rate (source amount columns are shifted between rows; agreement with a printed amount 99.94%); keep 549 exact duplicate rows but flag them; keep both raw amount columns. Nothing dropped, filled or invented. Lossless.
intended_use: Real-data business-question tasks with objectively computable answers (analytics / chat grounding); short-horizon daily product forecasting benchmark; price-vs-quantity descriptive analysis. NOT for churn, customer analysis, or any claim about SMEs in general.
backend_compatibility: NOT ingestible into the current product as-is: 36% of rows have fractional quantities (0.25 kg, 0.55 kg) but sales.quantity is an integer; no customer field; 1,682 free-text product names would need a products table. No backend change was made.
limitations: NC-SA licence restricts commercial and redistribution use
product names are truncated register abbreviations ('CAD DAIRY MIL')
